name: rowCumsums
title: Cumulative sums for each row in a matrix

origin.description: Cumulative sums for each row in a matrix.
origin.usage:
rowCumsums(x, rows = NULL, cols = NULL, dim. = dim(x), ...,
  useNames = TRUE)

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An NxK matrix or, if dim. is specified, an N * K vector.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of rows to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: A vector indicating a subset of columns to operate over. If NULL, no subsetting is done.

arguments.name: dim.
arguments.text: An integer vector of length two specifying the dimension of x, also when x is not a matrix.

arguments.name: useNames
arguments.text: If TRUE (default), names attributes of the result are set, otherwise not.

origin.details: The cumulative sum is taken across columns within each selected row. The result has one row per selected row and one column per selected column, in the order given by rows and cols. Logical x is returned as integer. An integer sum outside [-2147483647, 2147483647] is NA with a warning.
origin.value: A numeric matrix of the same shape as the selected x, with the same mode as x, except logical x is returned as integer.

translation.description: Cumulative sums for each row in a matrix.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An N by K array, or a one-dimensional vector when dim is given. A two-dimensional array is read with axis 0 as rows and axis 1 as columns, matching the printed R matrix.

arguments.name: rows
arguments.text: 1-based rows to include. None uses every row. Zeros are dropped and negative values exclude, as in R.

arguments.name: cols
arguments.text: 1-based columns to include. None uses every column. The cumulative sum follows this order.

arguments.name: dim
arguments.text: Two integers giving the shape of x, also when x is not a matrix. This is dim. When x is one-dimensional, the values fill that shape in column-major order.

arguments.name: use_names
arguments.text: Accepted for compatibility with useNames. The result is always a plain array; names are not attached.

translation.details: The sums come from the rowcumsums crate, ported from matrixStats src/rowCumsums.c with byrow TRUE. The result has the same shape as the selected matrix. Logical input returns int32. Double missing values are NaN and propagate across the row. An integer sum outside [-2147483647, 2147483647] is the int32 missing sentinel and warns.
translation.value: An array of shape (selected rows, selected columns). Double x returns float64. Integer and logical x return int32.
translation.example:
import numpy as np
from matrixstats.rowcumsums import rowCumsums

x = np.array([[1, 5, 9], [2, 6, 10], [3, 7, 11], [4, 8, 12]])
rowCumsums(x)
